title: manuscript-guard currency reply record
description: literature/currency/replies/<id>.<n>.yaml: one reply in Word to the comment `references --comments` wrote for a proposal of literature/currency.yaml, as Word kept it: the name Word gave its author, its date and its words. Filed by `import`, word for word, and sealed by `reply_sha256`. It decides nothing: a reader's assessment of it does (`references --assess`).

by.description: The name Word gives the reply's author: a label the replier's copy of Word was set to, not an identity.

date.description: The day Word dated the reply, or empty where it gave none.

comment.description: The digest of the comment it replies to, as the document recorded it.

word_id.description: The reply's own comment in Word: the w14:paraId of its first paragraph, else its w:id. Two replies of the same words to one comment are two replies.

decision.description: The digest of the proposal the comment showed: its action, candidate and rule ids.

written_on.description: The day the comment was written.

document.description: The name of the document it came back in.
